description: Create, update or delete a subnet within a given virtual network.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: address_prefix_cidr
parameters.description: CIDR defining the IPv4 address space of the subnet. Must be valid within the context of the virtual network.

parameters.name: address_prefixes_cidr
parameters.description: CIDR defining the IPv4 and IPv6 address space of the subnet. Must be valid within the context of the virtual network. If set address_prefix, It will not set.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: default_outbound_access
parameters.description: Set this property to false to disable default outbound connectivity for all VMs in the subnet. Choices: false true

parameters.name: delegations
parameters.description: An array of delegations.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: A list of actions. Default: []

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of delegation.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The type of the endpoint service. Choices: "Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters" "Microsoft.Web/serverFarms" "Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups" "Microsoft.Netapp/volumes" "Microsoft.HardwareSecurityModules/dedicatedHSMs" "Microsoft.ServiceFabricMesh/networks" "Microsoft.Logic/integrationServiceEnvironments" "Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts" "Microsoft.Sql/managedInstances" "Microsoft.Web/hostingEnvironments" "Microsoft.BareMetal/CrayServers" "Microsoft.BareMetal/MonitoringServers" "Microsoft.Databricks/workspaces" "Microsoft.BareMetal/AzureHostedService" "Microsoft.BareMetal/AzureVMware" "Microsoft.BareMetal/AzureHPC" "Microsoft.BareMetal/AzurePaymentHSM" "Microsoft.StreamAnalytics/streamingJobs" "Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/serversv2" "Microsoft.AzureCosmosDB/clusters" "Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces" "Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/singleServers" "Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers" "Microsoft.DBforMySQL/serversv2" "Microsoft.DBforMySQL/flexibleServers" "Microsoft.ApiManagement/service" "Microsoft.Synapse/workspaces" "Microsoft.PowerPlatform/vnetaccesslinks" "Microsoft.Network/managedResolvers" "Microsoft.Kusto/clusters" "Microsoft.App/environments"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: nat_gateway
parameters.description: Existing NAT Gateway with which to associate the subnet. It can be the NAT Gateway name which is in the same resource group. Can be the resource ID of the NAT Gateway. Can be a dict containing the name and resource_group of the NAT Gateway.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: private_endpoint_network_policies
parameters.description: Enabled or Disabled apply network policies on private endpoints in the subnet. Choices: "Enabled" ← (default) "Disabled" "NetworkSecurityGroupEnabled" "RouteTableEnabled"

parameters.name: private_link_service_network_policies
parameters.description: Enabled or Disabled apply network policies on private link service in the subnet. Choices: "Enabled" ← (default) "Disabled"

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of resource group.

parameters.name: route_table
parameters.description: The reference of the RouteTable resource. Can be the name or resource ID of the route table. Can be a dict containing the name and resource_group of the route table. Without this configuration, the associated route table will be dissociate. If there is no associated route table, it has no impact.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: security_group
parameters.description: Existing security group with which to associate the subnet. It can be the security group name which is in the same resource group. Can be the resource ID of the security group. Can be a dict containing the name and resource_group of the security group.

parameters.name: service_endpoint_policies
parameters.description: An array of service endpoint policies.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource ID of the service endpoint policy.

parameters.name: service_endpoints
parameters.description: An array of service endpoints.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: A list of locations.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The type of the endpoint service.

parameters.name: sharing_scope
parameters.description: Set this property to Tenant to allow sharing subnet with other subscriptions in your AAD tenant. Choices: "DelegatedServices" "Tenant"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Assert the state of the subnet. Use present to create or update a subnet and use absent to delete a subnet. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: virtual_network_name
parameters.description: Name of an existing virtual network with which the subnet is or will be associated.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Create a subnet
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    address_prefix_cidr: "10.1.0.0/24"

- name: Create a subnet refer nsg from other resource group
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    address_prefix_cidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
    security_group:
      name: secgroupfoo
      resource_group: mySecondResourceGroup
    route_table: route

- name: Create a subnet with service endpoint
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    address_prefix_cidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
    service_endpoints:
      - service: "Microsoft.Sql"
        locations:
          - "eastus"

- name: Create a subnet with delegations
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    address_prefix_cidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
    delegations:
      - name: 'mydeleg'
        serviceName: 'Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups'

- name: Create a subnet with an associated NAT Gateway
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    address_prefix_cidr: "10.1.0.0/16"
    nat_gateway: myNatGateway

- name: Delete a subnet
  azure_rm_subnet:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    virtual_network_name: myVirtualNetwork
    name: mySubnet
    state: absent

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: Current state of the subnet. Returned: success

return_values.name: address_prefix
return_values.description: IP address CIDR. Returned: always Sample: "10.1.0.0/16"

return_values.name: address_prefixes
return_values.description: IP address for IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR. Returned: always Sample: ["10.2.0.0/24", "fdda:e69b:1587:495e::/64"]

return_values.name: default_outbound_access
return_values.description: Set this property to false to disable default outbound connectivity for all VMs in the subnet. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: delegations
return_values.description: Associated delegation of subnets Returned: always

return_values.name: actions
return_values.description: list of actions associated with service of delegation Returned: when delegation is present Sample: ["Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets/action"]

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: name of delegation Returned: when delegation is present Sample: "delegationname"

return_values.name: serviceName
return_values.description: service associated to delegation Returned: when delegation is present Sample: "Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Subnet resource path. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroup/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/myVirtualNetwork/subnets/mySubnet"

return_values.name: network_security_group
return_values.description: Associated network security group of subnets. Returned: always

return_values.name: private_endpoint_network_policies
return_values.description: Enabled or Disabled apply network policies on private endpoints in the subnet. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.name: private_link_service_network_policies
return_values.description: Enabled or Disabled apply network policies on private link service in the subnet. Returned: always Sample: "Disabled"

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: Success or failure of the provisioning event. Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: service_endpoint_policies
return_values.description: An array of service endpoint policies. Returned: always Sample: ["/subscriptions/xxx-xxx/resourceGroups/TestRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/serviceEndpointPolicies/testpolicy"]

return_values.name: sharing_scope
return_values.description: Set this property to Tenant to allow sharing subnet with other subscriptions in your AAD tenant. Returned: always Sample: "None"
